payload.title: M. Coding-domain filter study
payload.description: Purpose: measure whether the 57-term coding-domain lexicon override should apply to the ML sentiment backends, not just VADER. Re-run tuning + held-out gold sets for vader, transformer-sst2, and transformer (go_emotions-mapped) in two configurations each (with/without a text-level filter variant), on a dedicated synthetic probe set of ordinary coding phrases plus genuinely negative same-word phrases. Done when: all six backend/config combinations reported (probe split, per-set accuracy, confusion matrices), a keep/adjust/remove recommendation implemented per-backend, tests and docs updated. Aggregate numbers only; no message text.
